_comment: Fast start + gradual loading (Roadmap 2, G1). Asset ids from data/assets.json; an id ending in '*' means every id that starts with it. qualities = only for these quality levels (leave out = all). boot = started the moment the settings are loaded, so they download WHILE the player signs in and the city is built (nothing waits for them in a queue). afterStart = downloaded one by one once the game is running, when the frame rate is fine (warms the offline copy, so buying a gun or reaching the MRT never waits). areas = downloaded only when Shoumik comes within 'radius' metres of 'at' [col, row] (road-grid junctions, see the map in docs/GAME_SPEC.md) — for the new areas of Roadmap 2 (airport, cantonment, river...). Roadmap 2 S3: one group per countryside zone of data/terrain.json (same id); src/world/terrain/ plants its props when the group has loaded. Roadmap 2 S4: one group per hotel (hotel-<id> of data/hotels.json, at = its junction): the inside and the 3D food are built when it has loaded; the doors stay shut until then. idleFps = afterStart files only load while the game runs at least this fast (areas load anyway: the player is walking into them). maxParallel = how many downloads at once after the start. Roadmap 2 S5: the 3D people (model.people + image.people.skins, Medium/High) come first in afterStart; the code-built crowd is shown until they arrive (src/entities/people/real/).
